A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Strict Subgoal Execution (SSE) research. Their complete 26-page texts, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–E are available and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original simulated reinforcement-learning experiments, including benchmark success rates, ablations, runtime measurements and additional seed evaluations in Section 5 and Appendices D–E.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendices D–E, including benchmark comparisons, runtime measurements, ablations and the ten-seed study.

M1.justification: FER, the exploration policies, failure-aware path refinement, graph construction and training losses remain unchanged, as do Algorithms 1–2. Changes from V_novel to V_n, ratio_fail to rho_f and c_dist to c_d rename symbols without altering the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same nine main AntMaze, KeyChest and Reacher tasks, the random-goal scenarios in Appendix D.1, and AntPush, AntFall and Ant4Rooms in Appendix E.3.

E2.justification: Figure 6 retains HIRO, HRAC, HIGL, DHRL, NGTE, PIG and BEAG. The corresponding appendix comparisons also retain their comparator sets, including BEAG and NGTE in Table 4 and Figure 20. Newly cited background methods are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The fixed-goal and random-goal protocols, success metrics, episode horizons and hyperparameter values in Tables 1–3 are unchanged. Appendix E.3 also retains the same graph-edge freezing procedure for AntPush.

E4.justification: Section 5.2 and Appendix E retain the same component ablations, trajectory studies and sensitivity analyses for path scaling, grid size, exploration ratio, reachability threshold and high-level discount factor. Relabeling parameters adds no analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report five-seed means with standard-deviation shading for the main comparisons. The ten-seed evaluation in Appendix E.4 and Figure 21 already appears in v2 and is unchanged in v3.

E6.justification: The plotted results, qualitative trajectories and Table 4 measurements are retained without numerical changes. For example, SSE on AntKeyChest remains at 18.13 seconds per episode and 1,658 episodes to reach 60% success. No result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: Definition 4.1 and Equations 1–12 retain their mathematical content after matching renamed symbols. The assumptions, objectives and derivations are unchanged; no theorem or proof is added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about FER, decoupled exploration, failure-aware refinement, shorter high-level decision horizons and improved success rates and efficiency. The rewritten introductory background does not change these contributions.

C2.justification: The explanations of subgoal reliability, exploration conservatism, grid/model tradeoffs and computational efficiency are retained. Section 6 preserves the same discussion of hyperparameter tuning and computational overhead.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces the direct SSE GitHub repository link with the SSE GitHub Pages project address, changing the resource access pointer. Implementation details, hardware and reproducibility disclosures otherwise remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish a change in actual resource availability.

R1.justification: The introduction adds Haarnoja et al. (2018) and Jo et al. (2026), and revises the grouping of prior sample-efficiency approaches. Other citation changes largely update publication information. SSE's substantive positioning relative to hierarchical, graph-based and relabeling methods remains stable.

P1.justification: The opening introductory paragraph is rewritten, several mathematical symbols are shortened across the main text and appendices, and bibliographic entries are revised. The section organization and most explanatory prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 8(b)'s label, Figure 15's caption and Table 3's header change c_dist to c_d, accompanied by limited spacing and page reflow. All 21 figures and four tables are retained, with unchanged plot graphics. Figure 15's legends still use c_dist.

improvement.justification: The revision preserves the method, empirical evidence and limitations. Citation updates and notation alignment in Figure 8(b) provide small editorial benefits, but relabeling is incomplete: Figure 15 retains c_dist in its legends, and Figure 3 retains ratio_fail after the main text switches to rho_f. Together with the changed code pointer, these limited edits leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
